classification.difficultyReason: Classify marked positional pairs in varied orientations and three-line figures without assuming parallelism.

content.prompt: Identify whether these angles are corresponding, alternate, or co-interior.

spec.description: Two horizontal parallel lines and an ascending transversal extending beyond both intersections. Both selected sectors are above their horizontal line and right of the transversal. Rightward parallel chevrons are upper-left and lower-right.
spec.mathematics: Matching positions on the same side of the transversal; two non-reflex arcs.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source geometry and selected-angle arcs are visible; classification belongs to the answer.

answer.worked: Corresponding: matching positions on the same side of the transversal.

spec.description: Horizontal parallel lines crossed by an ascending transversal. Upper selected sector is below-right; lower selected sector is above-left. Rightward parallel chevrons are upper-left and lower-right.
spec.mathematics: Interior sectors on opposite sides of the transversal; two non-reflex arcs.

answer.worked: Alternate: inside the two lines and on opposite sides of the transversal.

spec.description: Horizontal parallel lines with an ascending transversal. Upper sector is below-left; lower sector is above-left. Rightward parallel chevrons are upper-left and lower-right.
spec.mathematics: Interior sectors on the same side of the transversal; two non-reflex arcs.

answer.worked: Co-interior: inside the two lines and on the same side of the transversal.

spec.description: Horizontal parallel lines and an ascending transversal. Upper selected sector is below-left; lower selected sector is above-right. Rightward parallel chevrons are upper-left and lower-right.
spec.mathematics: Interior sectors on opposite sides of the transversal; two non-reflex arcs.

answer.worked: Alternate: inside the two lines and on opposite sides of the transversal.

spec.description: Two parallel lines rise rightwards. A descending-right segment joins the higher left intersection to the lower right intersection and stops at both. Selected sectors are above the segment, between the parallel lines. Up-right chevrons occur below the left intersection and above the right intersection.
spec.mathematics: Two interior angles on the same side of the connecting transversal. The transversal has no extensions.

answer.worked: Co-interior: between the parallel lines and on the same side of the connecting transversal.

spec.description: Horizontal parallel lines and an ascending transversal. Both selected sectors are below-left. Leftward parallel chevrons are upper-left and lower-right.
spec.mathematics: Matching positions on the same side of the transversal; two non-reflex arcs.

answer.worked: Corresponding: matching positions below the lines on the same side of the transversal.

spec.description: Two parallel lines rise rightwards, crossed by a descending-right transversal extending past both intersections. Both sectors lie between the up-right parallel arm and down-right transversal arm. Up-right chevrons are below the left and above the right intersection.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding positions; exactly two non-reflex arcs.

answer.worked: Corresponding: matching positions on the same side of the transversal.

spec.description: Two rising parallel lines crossed by an extended descending-right transversal. Left sector joins the up-right parallel arm to the down-right transversal arm; right sector joins the up-left transversal arm to the up-right parallel arm. Up-right chevrons are below-left and above-right.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles on the same side of the transversal; two non-reflex arcs.

answer.worked: Co-interior: between the parallel lines and on the same side of the transversal.

spec.description: Horizontal parallel lines crossed by an ascending transversal. Upper sector is below-right; lower sector is above-right. Rightward parallel chevrons are upper-left and lower-right.
spec.mathematics: Interior sectors on the same side of the transversal; two non-reflex arcs.

answer.worked: Co-interior: inside the two lines and on the same side of the transversal.

spec.description: Upper line rises shallowly rightwards; lower line falls shallowly. A steep descending-right transversal extends beyond both. Upper arc joins the upper line's left arm to the downward transversal arm; lower arc joins the lower line's left arm to the upward transversal arm. No parallel marks.
spec.mathematics: Co-interior is a positional classification and does not require parallel lines.

answer.worked: Co-interior: inside the two lines and on the same side of the transversal. The lines need not be parallel for this classification.

spec.description: Upper line rises shallowly rightwards; lower line falls very slightly. A nearly vertical transversal leans right as it rises. Upper arc is below-left and lower arc above-right. No parallel marks.
spec.mathematics: Alternate interior positions without an assumption of parallelism.

answer.worked: Alternate: inside the two lines and on opposite sides of the transversal. Parallelism is not required for this classification.

spec.description: Two shallow descending-right lines, upper steeper than lower, crossed by a more steeply descending-right transversal. Broad non-reflex arcs below both crossed lines join their left arms to the downward-right transversal arm. No parallel marks.
spec.mathematics: Matching positions on the same side of the transversal. Both arcs are non-reflex.

answer.worked: Corresponding: matching positions below the crossed lines on the same side of the transversal.

spec.description: Three horizontal parallel lines crossed by an ascending transversal extending beyond the outer intersections. Top arc is below-right; bottom arc above-right. No middle arc. Rightward chevrons occur left of the top intersection and right of the middle and bottom intersections.
spec.mathematics: The selected angles are co-interior relative to the outer lines. Preserve the middle line and its parallel mark.

answer.worked: Co-interior: between the outer parallel lines and on the same side of the transversal.

spec.description: Three descending-right parallel lines. An ascending-right transversal extends below the lowest intersection and terminates on the highest line. Lowest selected sector is between the up-right transversal and down-right parallel arm; highest selected sector is between the up-left parallel arm and down-left transversal. No middle arc. All chevrons point up-left, with the highest line's mark down-right of its intersection.
spec.mathematics: Alternate interior positions relative to the outer parallel lines. Preserve all three lines and the terminal top intersection.

answer.worked: Alternate: between the outer parallel lines and on opposite sides of the transversal.

spec.description: Three vertical parallel lines with upward chevrons. A rising-right segment starts on the left line, crosses the middle line and ends on the right line. Both arcs are below the transversal, inside the outer lines. Left and middle chevrons are above the segment; right chevron is below.
spec.mathematics: Co-interior positions relative to the outer lines. Preserve the middle line and both segment endpoints.

answer.worked: Co-interior: between the outer vertical parallel lines and on the same side of the transversal.
